$description: Design tokens, the single source of truth. `make tokens` writes design/tokens.css for the HTML prototypes and MyApp/DesignSystem/Generated (Tokens.swift + Colors.xcassets) for SwiftUI. Edit this file, never the outputs. Roles are semantic: components consume roles, never raw colours. Dark is a remap of the same roles.

bg.hover.description: Item hover fill: rows, menu items. Colour only, no movement.

bg.active.description: Pressed or selected fill: current tab, selected row.

surface.default.description: Cards, panels, sheets. Bounded by a hairline, never by a shadow.

surface.sunken.description: Wells inside a card: code blocks, nested lists, skeletons.

border.default.description: Default hairline. Decorative: it delimits, it is not a control boundary.

border.subtle.description: Faintest separator: inside dense lists, chart gridlines.

border.control.description: The only border allowed on an unfilled interactive control (input, unselected chip): reaches 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Never substitute border.default here.

text.muted.description: The ONLY second level of text: descriptions, labels, placeholders. AA on every surface.

action.primary.description: Primary button, links, selected state. ONE accent per app: the design phase replaces this neutral with the brand colour.

focus.description: Focus ring, at least 3:1 on every surface.

accent.default.description: Highlight for charts and non-text marks; never a page-level fill.

accent.text.description: Accent at body or small size.

positive.default.description: Success as a mark: icons, meters, large figures only.

positive.text.description: Success at body or small size.

warn.default.description: Warning as a mark. Always icon + label, never colour alone.

warn.text.description: Warning at body or small size.

danger.default.description: Error or destructive as a mark. Always icon + label.

danger.text.description: Error at body or small size.
